args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

src/money.py documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.

## Test plan
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` which asserts 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.
